description: This file defines a React functional component named RecoveryCodeBanner, which manages UI and logic related to displaying a recovery code for account recovery in a 2FA setup. It handles user interactions, makes asynchronous calls to get recovery codes, and renders the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onClickShow
methods.description: Asynchronous event handler triggered when the user clicks to show the recovery code. It prompts for account password verification and then retrieves and displays the recovery code or an error message.
